# Before You Think Guide

> Unofficial reading companion to Before You Think: System 0, AI-Mediated Cognition and Cognitive Colonization (arXiv:2606.13658v1).
> Authors: Marianna Bergamaschi Ganapini; Massimo Chiriatti; Enrico Panai; Giuseppe Riva.
> Conceptual/philosophical argument. No new experiments, replication, or validated diagnostic.

System 0 integration is gradual. Table 2 maps external literature and includes speculation.
Colonization is a proposed joint diagnostic, not an experimentally established category.
Source pages are one-based PDF pages, 1–32. No appendix is present.
